Name: Revived Custom Music based on ContentPatcher(ENandCN)
Author: PlumeQoQ
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#ea9999][size=3][center]This is an example pack, not a mod or a converter.[/center]
[/size][/color][/b][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]It only teaches you how to create your own music mod (add music to SDV). It includes how to write the content.json file for[/size][/font] [font=Comic Sans MS][size=3](Content Patcher) as well as methods for using SAAT2CP (Note: the unofficial update version of SAAT has an issue where music can only be heard halfway through).

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#ea9999][b]Example Pack Content Overview[/b]:[/color]
It includes pre-made JSON files that you only need to modify yourself. It also has illustrated guides and operation videos...
[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]I've posted the video from the example pack on [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1pHexeWE19]Bilibili (operation video)[/url]﻿. If you can access the site to watch the video, I recommend downloading the version→→→(No Video)
[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]I admit, this is easy to learn.

Please make sure to carefully read the pack I've written and pay attention to the details.
If you encounter any issues, first carefully check the details I mentioned. If you still can't resolve the problem, you can post about it.

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]I recommend using this mod in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6017?tab=files]Better Jukebox[/url]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#ea9999]Thanks to everyone on Discord who provided help![/color]
